## User Remediation Guidance
> **Plain-Language Remediation**:  
> Query get_stream to read the current accrued amount, then request at most that value or call withdraw_max.

---

## Reproduction

The following test code triggers this error condition:

```rust
let f = Fixture::setup_quiet();
let id = f.create_stream(DEPOSIT, DAY, 10 * DAY, false);
f.advance_time(2 * DAY);
rejected!(f.client.mock_all_auths().try_withdraw(&id, &(DEPOSIT / 10 + 1)));
```
